questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Overview of Computer Software and Programming Languages
questions.text: What are preprocessor directives? Explain preprocessor directives in C with examples.
Define Algorithm and Flowchart. List out general rules for flowcharting and explain how algorithms and flowcharts help in computer programming.
Explain the importance of problem analysis in software development. List the basic steps needed to be followed for developing software.
Write an algorithm and draw a flowchart to test whether a number entered by the user is even or odd.
Write an algorithm and draw a flowchart to find the sum of first n natural numbers where the value of n is entered by the user.
Write an algorithm and draw a flowchart to calculate the factorial of a positive integer.
Draw a flowchart to calculate the sum of digits contained in a number entered by the user.
Draw a flowchart to calculate the area of a triangle where the values of three sides (a, b, c) are read from the user using semi-perimeter formula.

questions.chapter: Chapter 3: C Language Fundamentals and Data Types
questions.text: What is an Identifier? Define Tokens, Keywords, Constants, and Variables in C. List down the rules for writing valid identifiers.

questions.chapter: Chapter 3: C Language Fundamentals and Data Types
questions.text: What are fundamental Data Types in C? Explain declaring variables and constants in C and FORTRAN.
What is an expression? Explain types of expressions, precedence, and associativity of operators in C with examples.
Explain Ternary (Conditional) Operator in C with a suitable programming example.
Explain how scanf() and printf() are used. Differentiate between formatted and unformatted input/output functions in C.
Write syntax and explain the use of unformatted character I/O functions: gets(), getchar(), getch(), getche(), and putchar().
Compare nested if statement with else-if ladder structure along with their flowcharts and syntax.
Differentiate between while loop and do-while loop in C. Explain entry-controlled and exit-controlled loops.
Explain the operation of break and continue statements in loop termination with suitable examples.
Write a C program to check whether a number entered by the user is Armstrong or not (for 3-digit and N-digit numbers).
Write a C program to check whether a number entered by the user is Prime or Composite.
Write a C program to check whether a given number or word is a Palindrome or not.
Write a C program to display nested loop number/star pattern (e.g., 2 4 / 3 6 9 / 4 8 12 16).
Write a C program to evaluate the cosine series: cos(x) = 1 - x^2/2! + x^4/4! - x^6/6! + ... until term value becomes less than 10^-5.
Define 1D and 2D Array. Explain compile-time and run-time initialization of one-dimensional and multi-dimensional arrays.
Write a C program to display the sum of two 3 x 3 matrices entered by the user.
Write a C program to display the transpose of an m x n matrix entered by the user.
Write a C program to display the largest and smallest number among 10 numbers entered by the user.
Write a C program to calculate the length of a string entered by the user without using library string functions.
Write a C program to reverse a string without using string handling functions.
Write a C program to concatenate two strings without using string handling functions.
Write a C program to read names of N countries and display them in alphabetical order.
Write a C program to display string pattern: H / HE / HEL / HELL / HELLO / HELL / HEL / HE / H.
Define Function Prototype, Function Call, and Function Definition with syntax and short examples.
Explain Call by Value and Call by Reference parameter passing methods with suitable examples.
Write a program to calculate the sum of cubes of first N natural numbers using a recursive function.
Write a program to display the factorial of an integer entered by the user using recursive function.
Write a program in C to display nth term / series of Fibonacci sequence using recursive function.
Write a recursive function program to compute x^y and explain how the execution stack works.
Write a recursive program to calculate the sum of digits of a given number until the sum becomes a single digit.
What is Structure? Why is it necessary? Explain nested structure with an example.
Write a program to define a structure named Person with Name, Address, Salary. Input details of 100 persons and display details in order of salary.
Write a program to add two distances given in feet and inch format using Structure.
Explain Array of Structure. Write a program to create a structure named Student (Roll, Name, Address, Marks) for 48 students and display students with marks between 50 and 70.
Write a program to create structure Karmachari (ID_Number, Name, Salary) for employees, and search records matching user input salary.
Explain nested structure Faculty having ServiceYear as a nested structure member. Display faculties with service duration > 10 and < 15 years.

questions.text: Define Void Pointer. Write a C program using pointers to multiply two 2D matrices (m x n and p x q) or display calculation error if incompatible.
Explain different file handling functions (fopen, fclose, fprintf, fscanf, fgetc, fputc, fread, fwrite) along with their syntax and examples.
Differentiate between Console I/O and File I/O, and Text File vs Binary File.
A file named "employee.txt" stores employee name, id, salary. Write a C program to display details of all employees having salary > 50000.
Write a program in C to copy the contents of file "source.txt" into "destination.txt".
Write a program to read positive integers from user and write all odd integers to ODD.txt and even integers to EVEN.txt.
Write a C program to write all prime numbers in range n1 to n2 into file "Source", copy to file "Destination", and display contents of "Destination".
Explain syntax and use of fseek() and rewind() functions in C file handling.
